---
title: "Module 14 — Pico Runtime SPI"
---

## The boundary

```
Pico definition
      │
PicoRuntime SPI
      │
  ┌───┴───┐
Native  Durable (celld-shaped)
```

## Operations

| Operation | Meaning |
|-----------|---------|
| `deploy` | Ensure identity exists |
| `invoke` | Send event, return state |
| `inspect` | Read state without mutation |
| `suspend` / `resume` | Optional lifecycle |
| `delete` | Remove identity + state |

## Capabilities

Runtimes advertise what they support (`DURABLE_STATE`, `MULTI_IDENTITY`, …).

## Contract tests

```
Pico Runtime Contract
        │
        ├── NativeRuntime  → PASS
        └── DurableRuntime → PASS
```

This proves the durable adapter implements **Pico semantics**, rather than redefining them.

```bash
PYTHONPATH=src python -m pytest tests/test_runtime_contract.py -q
```
